release_note.behavior: Randomized Kruskal now uses a flat iterative union-by-size disjoint set with path compression and stops immediately after V-1 accepted edges while preserving seeded raster goldens.
release_note.api: byul_maze_generate_randomized_kruskal adds replayable seed, cancellation, max_steps, max_cells, status, and failure-atomic output controls.
release_note.claim_boundary: The API promises randomized edge ordering and a perfect Maze, not minimum-weight or uniform-spanning-tree sampling.
release_note.compatibility: maze_make_kruskal remains exported as a deprecated ABI 1.x forwarder. Equal checked seeds preserve the pre-API raster order.
